summary: The four conservation lemmas close their goals only through an uncited definitional reduction of `![K.q, K.S] 0` to `K.q`, and the file ends with a prose section narrating an existence proof that is not present (the PR description claims a `@[sorryful]` uniqueness theorem that does not exist in the diff).
